contracts.convergence: Real filesystem links, managed > bot > shared, all collisions. The discovery folder must be absent or empty. Pre-existing directories and later user symlinks are preserved by refusal; no ownership marker exists.
contracts.loader: Real Pi skill discovery from the explicit folder while ambient project/global skills, AGENTS.md, settings and extensions are present.
contracts.worker: Real executor, guest, Pi relay and emulator in memory and standalone bundle modes. Pi catalog is visible and controller skill tools are absent.
contracts.index_and_usage: Shared content is never stored or exposed by the API. Managed reports are not stored. Mounted-source validation, per-attempt use/collision caps, one complete snapshot per attempt, attempt-start ordering including empty snapshots, secret refusal and completed-run fencing.
contracts.migration: Dry run, verified copy, repeated no-op, original preservation, executable mode and Unicode content. Reports every skipped, merged and conflicting bundle; compares full inventories, bytes and modes; independent bundles proceed.
contracts.managed: Legacy disable/override rows cannot hide managed skills and saved user collisions cannot shadow them.
contracts.ui: Web source-specific access controls and readonly viewer; desktop and phone-width captures.
contracts.legacy: Legacy rows remain editable beside same-name private and shared observations. No legacy row is hidden without migration provenance.

regression_proof.worker_base: Temporarily restored executor, generic guest and Pi adapter from b448499a2. Both real worker modes failed the new skill acceptance test because the model received the old catalog/tool behavior. Restored the implementation afterwards.
regression_proof.visibility_base: Temporarily restored pre-S8 managed/user precedence and visibility behavior. Both managed precedence/enablement regressions failed for the intended reason. Restored afterwards.
regression_proof.result: All four selected negative controls failed; the restored implementation passes the full unit suite.
regression_proof.round_1: New owner-boundary regressions failed on c3318e191 for native-tool routing, legacy visibility, stale ownership markers, explicit worker home, unmounted reports, frame caps, shared content/managed-row storage, snapshot ordering and migration conflicts. Fixed implementations then passed the full unit suite.

test_audit.method: Applied the authoring gate, read the SDK implementation and existing owner/sibling tests, and reviewed the final diff.
test_audit.changes: Replaced obsolete user-shadowing and managed-disable expectations. Preserved independent filesystem, protocol/bundle, database, secret-handling, migration and public UI contracts. Round 1 removes marker-rebuild expectations and managed-row storage expectations. New tests exercise filesystem preservation, process startup, hostile frames, real database state, editable API rows and operator migration output. The old-schema migration fixture now seeds spaces with SQL rather than a current-schema Prisma projection.
test_audit.seams: No test-only exports or flags. The session binding has a real coding-agent adapter caller; it keeps SDK-specific session code out of the shared runtime.

decisions.secrets: Known run-secret reports remain refused. Shared bodies are never stored, which prevents cross-bot body-secret indexing without needing every bot credential. Shared metadata, description and hash remain an untrusted observation.
decisions.computer_convergence: Deferred. Concurrent bots share one computer HOME and cannot safely rebuild one global folder with different private skill precedence. Existing managed mount and coding-agent discovery are retained.
decisions.learning: Worker native writes reach the skill list. The controller learning nudge remains in-process only; native writes do not yet generate learning footers.
decisions.shared_write: Accepted: a prompt-injected bot can plant a skill and script that other users' bots in the space load. Dedicated and team bots retain shared write access. Mitigations are deferred.
decisions.shared_index: A mounted shared writer can report nonexistent files or empty its snapshot. Reports do not attest to filesystem truth; bounds, mount scope and attempt ordering are enforced.

screenshots.native_ios: An iOS simulator was booted. The exact mobile screenshot command completed isolated PostgreSQL/backend setup but failed with spawn maestro ENOENT. Maestro is absent and no native app is installed in that simulator; no native capture is claimed.

changelog: Deferred to the final feature slice as required.

home_safety.isolation: Every test, script and bundle invocation used fresh temporary HOME and TMPDIR directories.
home_safety.backup: Both skill directory trees were backed up before any run.
home_safety.comparison: Recursive diff with symlink dereferencing disabled returned exit 0 for both backup comparisons; no differences. The ordinary recursive comparison also returned exit 0; the relocated relative links in the Claude skills backup produce missing-target notices, which the symlink-preserving comparison avoids.
